name: Cycle of Reincarnation
source:
If you've read, watched, or played anything in the "isekai" genre you know what to expect. Some random nobody from some weird world gets reincarnated into another world, giving them a second chance at life.

But what if this wasn't something random? What if every person went through this? What if you had a lot more control over your next life? 

This story attempts to take the idea of reincarnation and put a more natural spin on it, making it a natural order of the universe. It tells the story of a character who goes through this natural order, and what it would truly mean to take your memories from a previous life into a next one.

Although... maybe he should have clarified which gender he would end up as in his next life...

Oh well, too late now.

Follow along with Amy's new life in a fantasy world we all dream about. Learn about the world as she does, but as she will come to find out sooner or later.... the ideal of becoming a fantasy adventurer is not all it's cracked up to be. It's always painted in a pretty light, but honestly, things get brutal, violent, dangerous. You're not guaranteed to get out of it alive.

[From [url=https://phxntxm.itch.io/cycle-of-reincarnation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你读过、观看过或玩过“异界”类型的任何作品，你就知道会发生什么。来自某个奇怪世界的随机无人转世到另一个世界，给了他们第二次生命的机会。

但如果这不是随机的呢？如果每个人都经历过这个怎么办？如果你对下辈子有更多的控制权怎么办？

这个故事试图将轮回的想法赋予更自然的色彩，使其成为宇宙的自然秩序。它讲述了一个角色经历这种自然秩序的故事，以及将你前世的记忆带入下一世的真正意义。

虽然……也许他应该明确一下自己下辈子会是什么性别……

哦，好吧，现在太晚了。

跟随艾米在我们都梦想的奇幻世界中开始新生活。像她一样了解这个世界，但她迟早会发现……成为奇幻冒险家的理想并不像人们吹捧的那样。它总是被描绘得很漂亮，但老实说，事情变得残酷、暴力、危险。不保证你能活着离开它。

[来自[url=https://phxntxm.itch.io/cycle-of-reincarnation]itch.io[/url]]
